scenes.title: Claim Social Security at 62?
scenes.say: Claiming Social Security at sixty two?

scenes.label: of your full benefit if you claim at 62 (born 1960 or later)
scenes.say: Born in nineteen sixty or later? Claim at sixty two and you get about seventy percent, for life.

scenes.title: Monthly check vs. full benefit
scenes.say: Wait until seventy: one hundred twenty four percent. About seventy seven percent more a month.

scenes.title: Know your number before you claim.
scenes.say: Know your number before you claim. Follow for more money math.
